# Abacoa Podiatry & Leg Vein Center (jupiterlaser.com)

> Advanced foot and ankle care in Jupiter, Florida: FDA-cleared MLS laser therapy, shockwave therapy (EPAT), platelet-rich plasma (PRP), and regenerative cell treatments, led by board-certified foot and ankle surgeon Dr. Orlando Cedeno, DPM. An Abacoa Podiatry & Leg Vein Center practice.

Key facts:
- Address: 4601 Military Trail, Suite 202, Jupiter, FL 33458
- Phone: (561) 915-1934
- Hours: Monday-Thursday 8:00 AM - 5:00 PM, Friday 8:00 AM - 2:00 PM (closed for lunch 12:30-1:30 PM)
- Second office: 11380 Prosperity Farms Rd, Suite 204, Palm Beach Gardens, FL 33410
- Email: AbacoaPodiatry@gmail.com
- YouTube: https://www.youtube.com/@abacoapodiatryandlegveincenter
- Physicians:
  - Dr. Orlando Cedeno, DPM — board-certified foot & ankle surgeon; Barry University School of Podiatric Medicine & Surgery; surgical residency in reconstructive and trauma surgery at Chestnut Hill Hospital/University of Pennsylvania
  - Dr. Isin A. Mustafa, DPM, MSHS — foot & ankle surgeon; Western University of Health Sciences (DPM/MSHS with honors); PMSR/RRA residency at Chino Valley Medical Center (Chief Resident); focus on minimally invasive foot surgery (MIS), regenerative medicine, wound care, and sports medicine
- Service area: every city from West Palm Beach to Stuart — Jupiter, Abacoa, Palm Beach Gardens, Tequesta, Juno Beach, North Palm Beach, Lake Park, Riviera Beach, Singer Island, Hobe Sound, Port Salerno, Palm City, and Stuart
- Signature treatment: MLS (Multiwave Locked System) laser therapy — FDA-cleared, painless, 10-15 minute sessions, typical course 6-12 sessions

## Services
- [MLS Laser Therapy](https://jupiterlaser.com/services/mls-laser-therapy/): dual-wavelength (808 nm + 905 nm) laser for pain, inflammation, and tissue healing
- [Shockwave Therapy (EPAT)](https://jupiterlaser.com/services/shockwave-therapy/): acoustic wave treatment for chronic plantar fasciitis and tendinopathy
- [Stem Cell Therapy](https://jupiterlaser.com/services/stem-cell-therapy/): regenerative cell treatment for tendons, ligaments, and joints
- [PRP Therapy](https://jupiterlaser.com/services/prp-therapy/): platelet-rich plasma injections from the patient's own blood
- [Regenerative Medicine Programs](https://jupiterlaser.com/services/regenerative-medicine/): combined staged treatment plans
- [Foot BBL™](https://jupiterlaser.com/services/foot-bbl/): signature fat-pad restoration with Liposana™ or Sculptra for plantar fat pad atrophy — no liposuction, in-office, walk out same day
- [Advanced Wound Care](https://jupiterlaser.com/services/wound-care/): diabetic ulcer treatment and limb preservation
- [Foot & Ankle Surgery](https://jupiterlaser.com/services/foot-ankle-surgery/): bunion correction, reconstruction, trauma, minimally invasive (MIS) techniques
